sources.snippet: Its training builds on Gemma3-12B through four stages: (1) continual pretraining on 143 billion tokens of monolingual and parallel data across 46 languages, yielding MiLMMT-46-12B-Pretrain; (2) supervised finetuning, yielding MiLMMT-46-12B-v0.1; and (3) reinforcement learning; and (4) model merging, yielding this model, MiLMMT-46-12B-v1..
